title: Bug Hunt: Wrong Way
hints: This program came from the stairs back in the Frost Gate. These stairs go the other way. Run it and watch where it goes wrong.
Only the turns need fixing. Going up to the left, you turn right first, then left.

story.intro: PATCH: "VANTA left a scrambled program in this bot. It almost works. Run it, see where it breaks, and fix it. That's called debugging."
